contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Gratian (367-383), probably Vow in Wreath issue of 379-383, possibly Lyon mint, Reece period 20. Obverse description: Bust draped and cuirassed right, fairly small. Obverse inscription: DN GRA[---]. Reverse description: Vow in wreath: VOT/XV/MVLT/XX. In exergue: possibly [PL]VGD. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 1.00gms, die axis: 12
